message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I could almost hear my kids' excitement bubbling up! Instead of the usual panic, we turned it into a little adventure. I grabbed our trusty lantern and some power banks for our phones while they set up a fort in the living room. We ended up playing board games by lantern light, and I realized how easy it is to make the best out of a not-so-ideal situation. Now I keep our emergency gear in a designated spot so we can be ready for our next adventure—because who says a blackout can’t be fun? What’s your favorite way to keep the mood light during unexpected power outages? ☀️
